schema.recruiter: string — key, from the opportunity 'source' field
schema.firm: string — same as recruiter unless the current data model distinguishes them (it doesn't yet)
schema.specialisation: array of strings — ranked domainTags observed across this contact's sourced opportunities
schema.industries: array of strings — industries of companies this contact introduced (from CRM)
schema.countries: array of strings — regions inferred from sourced opportunities' location/description text
schema.rolesHired: array of strings — opportunity titles sourced from this contact
schema.responseHistory: array — {date, company, channel, summary}, from CRM outreachHistory for attributed companies
schema.relationshipBand: string — Hot | Warm | Cooling | Cold | Unknown
schema.responseRate: number 0-100 or null — % of attributed companies with existingRelationship beyond 'none'
schema.successRate: number 0-100 or null — % of sourced opportunities whose pipeline stage is 'won'
